issue.title: Reassess the Day strip typical-day line after three weeks of use

task_type_fields.proposal: Proposed by bob-cli-cn.3 note #2; required follow-up from plan:202610/day_strip_typical_day.md. Around 2026-11-16, check whether Bryan has had about three weeks with visible typical-day lines (plugin 1.77.0 deployed 2026-10-26, but lines remain blank until the bob release train delivers typical JSON). If visible exposure started later, snooze to roughly three weeks after that date. Ask Bryan: (1) did the line change a decision or usefully reassure you? (2) did you catch yourself working to beat the typical number? Also ask whether the marks distract. Record his answers. Keep the feature if useful; if he never looks at it, remove the reference line in the plugin only; if he chases it, show lines only on finished days; if only marks distract, drop marks while retaining the reference. Implement only the branch his feedback supports, with appropriate focused tests/build/docs and bob plugins sync. Do not fabricate feedback or infer approval from silence. The decision strand was declined in the epic, so the approved plan is the source of these review actions.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: This is the explicitly requested post-deployment reassessment, not a defect or prerequisite for v1 landing. It needs lived-use evidence available only after about three weeks. The bounded questionnaire and predefined plugin-only responses fit size small.

issue.creation_reason: The approved bob-cli-cn plan requires a delayed exit check; phase bob-cli-cn.3 proposed it and the lander found no existing equivalent task.

snooze.reason: Approved epic exit check after about three weeks of visible use; worker must adjust if the bob release train delayed availability.
